Explanation:  
The question is about the head-to-head record between Novak Djokovic (World No. 1 at the end of the 2016 French Open) and Andy Murray (2016 Australian Open runner-up) as of the END of the 2016 French Open. The Ground Truth Answer is "Novak Djokovic 24-10 Andy Murray," which means Djokovic had 24 wins and Murray had 10 at that point. The Predicted Answer states "Djokovic led Murray 23–10" and notes that "Djokovic increased his advantage by defeating Murray in the French Open final," but it does not update the record to 24-10. Thus, the Predicted Answer gives the head-to-head prior to the final (23-10), rather than including the French Open final, which is what is required for the correct end-of-French Open answer.

Decision: FALSE
